correct_completion: it left a lasting impression on everyone who read it.
full_sentence: Although the poem was short, it left a lasting impression on everyone who read it.
acceptable_variants: it still moved many readers deeply.
it made readers think for days.

options.why_wrong: 'Although' signals contrast, not result. 'So' introduces a result, so this does not complete the contrast.

options.text: it was written in free verse.
options.why_wrong: This describes the poem but does not complete the contrast started by 'although'.

options.text: it left a lasting impression on everyone who read it.
the poet had many other books.
options.why_wrong: This adds unrelated information and does not provide the contrasting result expected after 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must show a contrast with the first part of the sentence. Here, the poem's short length is contrasted with its strong effect on readers. Learners sometimes use 'so' after a concessive clause because they confuse contrast with cause, so check the connector carefully.
translation: Embora o poema fosse curto, ele deixou uma impressão duradoura em todos que o leram.
